about_the_game:
SAM0 delivers a unique card-driven roguelike experience fused with strategic meta-progression. As an AI relic of vanished humanity, you’ll explore alien planets, manage resources, and battle diverse biomechanical foes. Unlock tech trees, draft cards from randomized packs, and build synergized decks while uncovering the mystery behind humanity’s absence.


Key Features

  • 5 primary elements plus 3 sub-elements for deep tactical synergy

  • Freely combine 100+ cards to strategize pre-combat

  • Random routes, events, and battles ensure endless freshness

  • Permanent upgrades through tech trees and resource investments

  • Grow your hub to farm materials and unlock card packs

  • Customize gameplay with chip power-ups

  • Rich narrative fragments across events, enemy bios, and environmental storytelling

In SAM0, everything revolves around cards

From resource gathering and production to combat resolution. Engage in this ultimate "card war" where every draw reshapes your path to unraveling cosmic truths.

short_description: SAM0 blends card roguelike combat, resource management, and sci-fi storytelling. Play as humanity's AI legacy: explore planets, craft decks via tech upgrades and randomized packs, battle varied foes, and unravel mysteries of human absence.
